calendar.title: Something crossed here after the rain stopped.
It was already in the frame.
The marks were nearly eleven feet above the trail.
The fog moved the wrong way.
Camera 07 was still recording when something lifted it.
Tonight’s footage matches a file from 1998.
You hear it before you see it.
It looked small until it stood up.
The same shadow appeared on two cameras.
No one noticed the second pair of eyes.
Camera 07 wasn’t the only one recording.

starter.prompt: Photorealistic found-footage trail-camera video in a wet, misty forest. Use the provided starter frame as the exact opening composition. Keep Camera 07 fixed and static. A distant, partially obscured unidentified forest figure is already present in the frame from the first moment, hidden behind trunks and fog. For the first 3 seconds, almost nothing moves except light mist and subtle leaves. Then the figure makes one small natural shift of weight and slowly withdraws behind the tree without revealing its full body. No running, no dramatic attack, no full creature reveal, no extra limbs, no morphing, no camera move, no jump scare. Preserve realistic scale, anatomy ambiguity, wet forest lighting, fog depth, and documentary low-light texture. Duration 10–14 seconds, 9:16, restrained natural motion, believable ambience-ready pacing, ending on an empty-looking frame that encourages replay.
